title: Proactive Assistance on Incident Records
story: As a fulfiller, I want to access Proactive Assistance directly on the Incident page, so that I can receive recommendations and investigate issues more effectively.

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am an authorized fulfiller on an Incident page
acceptanceCriteria.when: I access the Proactive Assistance panel
acceptanceCriteria.then: I can interact with the Agent and receive recommendations

acceptanceCriteria.given: I interact with the Agent on the Incident page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Agent responds within agreed performance expectations
relevant and accurate information is returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: information is unavailable for the Agent to provide
acceptanceCriteria.then: an appropriate message is shown explaining unavailability

acceptanceCriteria.given: I am not an authorized fulfiller
acceptanceCriteria.when: I attempt to access Proactive Assistance
acceptanceCriteria.then: access is restricted and I cannot interact with the Agent

acceptanceCriteria.given: Proactive Assistance is loaded on the Incident page
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Incident page performance and loading behavior are not negatively impacted

edgeCases: Agent suggests an action that conflicts with current incident state
Multiple fulfillers accessing Agent on the same incident simultaneously
Agent recommendation references a deleted knowledge article
Agent session timeout during a complex investigation
